about: The Swagger of Swaggers on promptugal.news/apis/ (Dinis, 18 November 2026, about 16:00 UTC: board/guidance/2026-11-18-the-pipeline-standard-and-the-fact-checker.md): every PrompTugal site's OpenAPI document, one picker, the vendored Swagger UI. A site is listed once its document answers. dev@PrompTugal.dinis.
title: Every PrompTugal API
summary: One page for the APIs of every PrompTugal site: pick a site and call its endpoints. GET only, all public, no key.
md: Every PrompTugal site publishes its data as JSON with an OpenAPI document. Pick a site below and its endpoints load here, ready to call. They are all plain GET calls on public files: no key, no account.
Each document is fetched by your browser straight from that site. A site joins the list once its document is published.
no_js: The picker needs JavaScript. The documents are linked above, one per site.
